title: It works
body: This app has helped me focus so much when I was most frustrated by not being able to move my life forward. It really is worth it. Thank you to the creators, you really are making a difference.
author: Nat Roldan

title: Funny and beautiful
body: I love the magical graphics and like the sense of humor -no motivacional corny style, but light and funny.
author: Dania M. Vándalos

title: Lo malo: el celular
body: Estas aplicaciones serian muy buenas si no tuvieras que traer em celular contigo para usarlas.
author: Pollipato
